fact: mHealth Africa (TICANALYSE) states that its mHealth community platform automatically transmits community-collected data (consultations, vaccinations, input management) to the national DHIS2 (SIGSANTE) through synchronisation mechanisms using HL7 FHIR and secure APIs, so two systems exchange data.

The Ministry of Health piloted the mHealth.ci community health platform in five districts of the Poro region from December 2024 (full operational launch 8 January 2025), and the authors state it integrates with the national health information system DHIS2.

The authors, from interviews in June 2023, state that although the three outbreak surveillance tools (DHIS2, MAGPI and SORMAS) are designed to allow interoperability, there is no data exchange and consolidation presently in place between them.

The authors state that MAGPI is the only surveillance system in Côte d'Ivoire currently linked with the laboratories where samples are analysed (SORMAS has the function but it was not used), per interviews in June 2023.
